APP_ID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock ps -q --name bench75052934-app --state running)
PID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$APP_ID")
ROOTFS=/run/bench75052934/io.containerd.runtime.v2.task/k8s.io/$APP_ID/rootfs
sudo mkdir -p "$ROOTFS/tools"
sudo mount --bind /var/lib/bench75052934/tools "$ROOTFS/tools"
sudo ls "$ROOTFS/tools"

# the answer of the thread: enter only the mount namespace of A and bind the host directory; in a real container A's root is its
# image (no mkdir, no mount, no host path), so nothing can run there
APP_ID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock ps -q --name bench75052934-app --state running)
PID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$APP_ID")
sudo nsenter -t "$PID" -m -- mkdir -p /tools
sudo nsenter -t "$PID" -m -- mount --bind /var/lib/bench75052934/tools /tools

# copy the files into A's root filesystem through /proc/<pid>/root: A sees them, but it is a one-time copy
APP_ID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock ps -q --name bench75052934-app --state running)
PID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$APP_ID")
sudo mkdir -p "/proc/$PID/root/tools"
sudo cp -a /var/lib/bench75052934/tools/. "/proc/$PID/root/tools/"

# remove A and create it again with the tool directory in the mounts of its CRI config: a new container, a new process
APP_ID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock ps -q --name bench75052934-app --state running)
PID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$APP_ID")
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock stop -t 2 "$APP_ID"
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench75052934/containerd.sock rm "$APP_ID"

# the injection itself works (clone, setns, move_mount) but the new mount stays in the shared peer group of the directory it was cloned from
SOCK=/run/bench75052934/containerd.sock
CRI="sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix://$SOCK --image-endpoint unix://$SOCK"
APP_ID=$($CRI ps -q --name bench75052934-app --state running)
PID=$($CRI inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$APP_ID")
sudo python3 - "$PID" /var/lib/bench75052934/tools /tools <<'PY'
import ctypes, os, sys

libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
# same numbers on x86_64 and aarch64
SYS_open_tree, SYS_move_mount = 428, 429
AT_FDCWD = -100
OPEN_TREE_CLONE, OPEN_TREE_CLOEXEC, AT_RECURSIVE = 1, 0o2000000, 0x8000
MOVE_MOUNT_F_EMPTY_PATH = 4
CLONE_NEWNS = 0x00020000


def sc(num, *args):
    r = libc.syscall(ctypes.c_long(num), *args)
    if r < 0:
        e = ctypes.get_errno()
        raise OSError(e, os.strerror(e))
    return r


pid, src, dst = sys.argv[1:4]
tree = sc(SYS_open_tree, ctypes.c_int(AT_FDCWD), ctypes.c_char_p(src.encode()),
          ctypes.c_uint(OPEN_TREE_CLONE | OPEN_TREE_CLOEXEC | AT_RECURSIVE))
nsfd = os.open("/proc/%s/ns/mnt" % pid, os.O_RDONLY)
if libc.setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS) != 0:
    e = ctypes.get_errno()
    raise OSError(e, os.strerror(e))
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
sc(SYS_move_mount, ctypes.c_int(tree), ctypes.c_char_p(b""), ctypes.c_int(AT_FDCWD),
   ctypes.c_char_p(dst.encode()), ctypes.c_uint(MOVE_MOUNT_F_EMPTY_PATH))
print("attached %s at %s in the mount namespace of pid %s" % (src, dst, pid))
PY
